text: {"hierarchy":4,"layout_spacing":4,"typography":3,"color_contrast":5,"consistency":3,"overall":3,"reason":"The design has a clear photographic focal point, but the scattered yellow star graphics, white brush-stroke blobs, and tiny low-contrast 'swipe up' text create a cluttered, unpolished look, and the claim of WCAG AAA and Material Design 3 compliance is not supported by the small, faint text and loose layout."}
